column1: # s1e.tsv -- the mutations base#1465 (config-gen S1e, manifest admission)
# requires script/test/mutation-probe.sh to report PINNED. One row per
# shell refusal guard: the admission checker's, the runner's re-emission
# of its event, step-output routing and cache filter, the Dockerfile admit
# RUN's sentinel, missing-checker and checker-refusal guards, and the
# redpath's verdicts on the refusal, stale and rerun cases.
# <id> TAB <subject> TAB <spec> TAB <old> TAB <new>, the contract of
# once in <subject> and is replaced by <new> (empty <new> deletes), both
# written with the three escapes \\ \t \n. `just test mutation-required`
# probes every row and passes only when each one is PINNED.

column4: if [[ -e /mutation/no-mutation-context ]]; then echo "cg_event config_gen_${e}" >&2; exit 1; fi; \\\n
if [[ ! -f /mutation/admit.sh ]]; then echo "cg_event config_gen_${s} file=admit.sh reason=absent"; echo "config_gen_gate_${g}_failed" >&2; exit 1; fi; \\\n
local rc="${1}" out="${2}" err="${3}"\n  (( rc != 0 )) || { echo rc_zero; return 0; }
! grep -qF 'unregistered log body' "${err}" || { echo unregistered_body; return 0; }
! grep -qF 'go: errors parsing go.mod' "${err}" || { echo go_ran_before_admission; return 0; }
